name: How long does it take to replace all the flooring in a foreclosed home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace all the flooring in a foreclosed home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical whole-home flooring installation in a foreclosed property takes between three and seven working days. The overall duration depends heavily on the extent of necessary prep work and demolition. If old, moldy carpet or broken tile requires extensive removal, or if the subfloor needs structural repair, tear-out adds one to two days. Actual installation proceeds quickly once subfloors are level and dry. Owner Abraham Becerra oversees the site directly to coordinate subfloor fixes and finish carpentry, ensuring trim and baseboard adjustments happen immediately after the new floor is laid.
acceptedAnswer.description: Whole-home flooring installation usually takes three to seven working days, depending on demo requirements and subfloor repairs.
